$description: Design tokens extracted from the Figma design file. The file defines no Figma Variables (get_variable_defs returned {}), so every value below was measured from the actual styles applied to the design nodes. Node ids are recorded so each value can be traced back.

background.$description: Page background. The whole design sits on black.

surface.$description: Raised panel. Measured on the 'since 2006' box.

overlay.$description: Scrim behind the section-link band. Applied together with opacity 0.8.

border.$description: Outlined boxes: logo, nav buttons, service cards.

gradient.$description: The four stops of the brand gradient, in order.

brand.$description: Applied as a background-clip: text fill on most headings and eyebrows. In Figma the angle varies per node between 92.06deg and 96.76deg; 95deg is the rounded representative value. The fourth stop sits at 106.11% in Figma, which CSS clamps to 100%.

display.$description: Headings, numerals, logo, nav band labels.

body.$description: Body copy, eyebrows, nav button labels.

light.$description: Unbounded Light - all display headings and numerals.

semibold.$description: Unbounded SemiBold - logo wordmark and tagline.

fontSize.$description: Measured in px. The rem equivalents assume the project's 62.5% root, where 1rem = 10px.

$extensions.usage: Eyebrow text and nav button labels (Inter)
Logo wordmark (Unbounded SemiBold) and hero lede (Unbounded Regular)
Step numerals 01-04 and project titles (Unbounded Light)

lineHeight.$description: Unitless, as the coding guideline requires. Figma reports 'normal' on most text; the one explicit value in the file is 17px on 14px type (node 506:382), which is the basis for the body ratio.

squiggle.$description: -9.6px on 48px type, expressed relative so it scales.

layout.$description: The desktop grid. 96 margin + 4 columns of 240 + 3 gutters of 96 = 1440.

container.$description: Max width for any section that does not fill the screen. Stated explicitly on the Direction page, not measured - the frames in the design itself wobble between 1249 and 1250.

margin.$description: (1440 - 1250) / 2. Column origins in the design read 96, 432, 768, 1104, so individual frames sit 1px off; the container is what governs.

half.$description: Half the container - the 2-up card width.

mobile.$description: iPhone SE, the mobile design width named in the brief.

container-mobile.$description: Mobile equivalent of the container rule, stated on the Direction page.

spacing.$description: Recurring measured gaps only - no invented steps.

size.$description: Fixed component dimensions taken straight from the design.

avatar.$description: Circular masked portrait on the service cards.

default.$description: Every outlined box in the design uses a 2px solid white border.

none.$description: Figma names the shapes 'rounded-rectangle' but every corner radius in the file resolves to 0.

hover.$description: From the coding guideline, not the Figma file: PC hover state for buttons and links.

scrim.$description: Layer opacity on the section-link band, on top of its 70% black fill.

hover.$description: From the coding guideline, not the Figma file.

pc.$description: From the coding guideline. The single breakpoint; below it the mobile layout applies.
